app.title: Redlands Parks
app.description:
This app opens a public web map of parks in Redlands, California, with ten bookmarks saved in it. The bookmarks list is open when the app starts: choose a park to go there, or add the current view as a bookmark of your own, kept in this browser for next time.

The legend opens from the button below it, in the same corner, so opening one closes the other. A scale bar sits at the bottom left, and the button at the top right shows the whole app fullscreen.

This is a sample app. Point map.item at your own web map with bookmarks, or remove it from apps/index.json.
